---
title: "check-solution-citations.yml"
---

Diff-scoped, blocking check that flags a citation of a solution inside a proof or result div.
A derivation never cites a solution to an exercise.
A solution that a later argument relies on is followed by a result div (`#thm-`, `#lem-`, `#cor-` or `#prp-`),
and the later argument cites that result div.
This implements
[gha#1234](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/1234).

The check reports a cross-reference `@sol-...` on a line inside a `proof` div
or a `#thm-`, `#lem-`, `#cor-` or `#prp-` div, including a div nested in one.
The finding sits on the line that holds the reference.

## Exceptions

The one exception is an exercise that asks students to prove a result before the result is stated.
The result's proof may then cite the solution that precedes it.
The check does not flag:

- a line carrying `<!-- check-solution-citations: allow -->`,
  the explicit mark for that exception;
- a line that says "the solution to @exr-...",
  the lab's existing wording for a result whose exercise asks for the proof;
- a `@sol-` reference outside a proof or result div, such as in another solution;
- lines inside a code fence, display math (`$$`), an HTML comment or inline code.

## Scope

Only an added line is reported.
The whole file is parsed, since the div opens far above the changed line.
An added line whose exact text was also deleted in the same diff counts as moved.
With no `base-ref`, or when the diff cannot be computed,
the check skips with a warning instead of scanning the whole tree.
Set `whole-tree: true` to scan every tracked file on purpose,
which measures how many existing proofs cite a solution.
`fail` defaults to `true`, because a diff-scoped check reflags nothing already merged.

## Usage

Copy
[`examples/check-solution-citations.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/check-solution-citations.yml)
to `.github/workflows/` in your repository.

## Inputs

| Input | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `globs` | `*.qmd` | Space-separated git pathspecs of tracked files to check |
| `paths-ignore` | empty | Comma- or newline-separated glob patterns to skip |
| `fail` | `true` | Fail the workflow on a finding instead of warning |
| `whole-tree` | `false` | Scan every proof, not only a pull request's additions |
| `runs-on` | `ubuntu-latest` | Runner label; self-hosted only for a private repository |
| `python-version` | `3.x` | Python version to set up |

## Permissions

The job needs `contents: read` only.

## Example

```yaml
name: Check proofs for solution citations

on:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  check:
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/check-solution-citations.yml@v3
    with:
      paths-ignore: 'chapters/outtakes/**'
```
